transferable_lessons: For entity-recognition questions with short temporal certificates and a strong narrative clue (named boss + adjacent scripted event), a simple run_sql time-range or keyword-LIKE scan over episodes/topic_facts is often sufficient and more reliable than depending on semantic_search embedding quality alone.

When both dense episode captions and structured topic_facts rows contain the same fact, cross-checking between the two tables adds robustness without extra cost, since both were consistently used across rollouts.

SQL join errors from duplicate unaliased column names (e.g. joining event_chains and event_steps which share start_s/end_s/description names) are a common but recoverable failure mode; agents should alias columns proactively rather than reactively fixing after an error.
